mapper.select: SELECT schedule_type AS "scheduleType", schedule_id AS "scheduleId", qty AS "qty", target_month AS "targetMonth", target_date AS "targetDate" FROM delivery_carryover

SELECT name AS "name", spec AS "spec", COALESCE((SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'STORAGE_METHOD' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = storage LIMIT 1), storage) AS "storage" FROM products
